{{Quote|While Coruscant has always been considered the heart of the Republic, to some extent, Alderaan has been its soul.|A HoloNet dossier on Alderaan|<ref name="Alderaan" />}}
'''Alderaan''', located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] and the home of many famous heroes, including [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], and [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]. Renowned [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] for their planet's unspoiled beauty, refined culture, and commitment to peace, Alderaanians worked with and around the land to preserve as much of the natural surroundings as they could.

Originally the home of the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], Alderaan was later conquered by Humans. Despite a [[Battle of Alderaan|battle]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and a [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] during the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Alderaan remained peaceful during much of galactic history. However, in attempt to force the Galaxy into submission, [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] the unarmed and peaceful planet using the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==History==
===Pre-Republic===
[[File:Killikmounds.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Petrified mounds of the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] in the [[Castle Lands]].]]
A lush, mountainous world, the native [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] evolved from the most intelligent [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] species on the planet circa [[1,000,000 BBY]].<ref name="Illustrated">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> Constructing massive hives, such as in the [[Castle Lands]] near Oroboro, the Killiks ruled the planet until departing the world and colonizing nearby [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and later departing for deep space after consuming all of Alderaan's natural resources.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists came to the planet from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], via the [[Herglic Trade Empire]], in [[27,500 BBY]] and built a peaceful civilization in harmony with nature. Settlers were attracted from across the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], drawn by Alderaan's natural beauty. Eventually the Alderaanian monarchy came into existence, and with it the implementation of many laws designed to preserve the environment.<ref name="TOR" />

===Old Republic===
Alderaan was a [[Core Founder/Legends|founder]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the planet was threatened with invasion by the forces of [[Cassus Fett]], but the entire invasion force was prematurely [[Disaster on Jebble|obliterated]] due to misuse of the [[Muur Talisman]], an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifact, which transformed the Mandalorians into [[rakghoul]]s.<ref name="KotOR 26">[[Knights of the Old Republic 26|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 26]]</ref>

[[File:Alderaan-Hope.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Alderaan's picturesque landscape just prior to the Battle of Alderaan]]
During the peak of the [[Great Galactic War]], the planet's peace and tranquility was shattered by a full-scale [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Battle of Alderaan|invasion]]. The Sith quickly overwhelmed the local defense forces and took the entire [[House Panteer|royal family]] hostage. In response, a Republic and Jedi task force launched a swift counter-offensive against the Sith; recapturing the planet and inflicting a heavy defeat on the Sith.<ref name="Alderaan" />

As a consequence of the Sith invasion, the Alderaanian leadership adopted a hardline militarist stance towards the Sith Empire in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="Alderaan" /> In [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Deceived" /> the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] ended the decades-long conflict in favor of the Sith Empire, which had earlier launched a [[Sacking of Coruscant|devastating attack]] on the galactic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In protest, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Gaul Panteer]], the Alderaanian [[Prince/Legends|Crown Prince]], walked out of the Senate and withdrew Alderaan from the Republic.<ref name="Alderaan" />

The crown prince's actions created much division in Alderaan. While many supported his actions, others were outraged by the secession from the Republic. The crisis worsened with the assassination of the prince and the death of his [[Silara Panteer|mother]] a few days later. The [[Alderaanian Parliament]] was quickly torn apart by infighting between rival houses. A [[Alderaan Civil War|bloody civil war]] quickly ensued when one of these houses attempted a military coup.<ref name="Alderaan" />

[[File:Alderaan_TOR_New.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Alderaan during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]]]
In the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Interstellar Cold War]] between the Republic and the Sith, the planet was the site of a number of border skirmishes and proxy battles between Republic and Sith forces. The Republic backed [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] while the Sith backed the formerly exiled [[House of Thul]], which sought to reclaim the throne. Neither side had military forces on Alderaan.<ref name="Alderaan" /> Around the same time, the [[Museum of Antiquities]] ordered a shipment of rare artworks which was however intercepted and replaced with worthless copies of the paintings made by the famous commercial artist [[Ornas Lodin]].<ref name="Art" />

During the conflict with the [[Eternal Empire]], [[Malika Sturm]] hosted the cenntenial [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]] race in the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Alderaan.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Off to the Races}}</ref> Alderaan was also one of the worlds where there was a [[Star Fortress]] put in orbit, but it was destroyed in [[3631 BBY]].<ref name="KOTFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

During the last five centuries of the Old Republic, Alderaan nobility was known to enjoy the seafood from [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] distributed by [[Bartyn Gourmet Delicacies]].<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Alderaan was personally protected by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] during the [[Ashaar Khorda]] crisis.<ref name="Zam Wesell">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
[[File:CR70_alderaan.png|thumb|left|300px|The [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']] lands in [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], right after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
As a whole, Alderaan strongly opposed the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]; they had their own [[Alderaanian Security|security forces]], but remained loyal to the Republic during the Clone Wars. Alderaan allowed [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] settlement by displaced exiles from [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] (including [[Orogor Binn]] and [[Sandi Maba]] and her family<ref name="HN9N" />) and other [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] worlds who wished to remain Republic citizens. Due to its assistance of these exiles, Alderaan was attacked personally&mdash;nearly "being destroyed"&mdash;by General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

With the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]] and [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] adopted [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Amidala Skywalker]].<ref name="RotS" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] violently terminated the [[Jedi Praxeum (Alderaan)|Jedi Praxeum]] on the planet, though a few students escaped. Shortly afterwards, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ylenic It'kla]] led a remnant of the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] people to settle on Alderaan after [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] desolated [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. Ylenic served as [[Trustant]] of the [[Caamasi Remnant]] and adviser to the Organas.

===Imperial era===
{{Quote|For all their talk of being a peaceful planet, Alderaan had been thumbing its nose at the Empire for years.|Unnamed 501st stormtrooper|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Aldnds3.png|thumb|right|300px|The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] looms over Alderaan.]]
Immediately after the formation of the Galactic Empire, Alderaan was wracked by anti-Imperial protests, mainly from alien refugees who were now forced to pay an exorbitant tax to return home. Alderaan eventually became a safe haven for rebellious elements who wished to fight the growing oppression of the Empire, which helped bring on the planet's very downfall. As such, Alliance popularity on the planet was massive enough that the [[Alderaan Guard/Legends|Alderaan Guards]] often paid visits to families to inform them of any deaths in the service to the Alliance, at least one example being [[Kissek Doran]].<ref name="Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

After the horrors of the Clone Wars, Alderaan adopted pacifism and banned major weaponry, perhaps as a move to allow Bail Organa to oppose the Imperial policies, while not being accused for treason or rebellion.<ref name="TEA" /> Alderaan's frigates and light cruisers were dismantled and the world's defensive armaments and superweapons were placed aboard the armory warship ''[[Another Chance]]''.<ref name="ForceUnleashed">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref><ref name="CatCW" /> The ship was programmed to continually jump though hyperspace until called home by the [[High Council of Alderaan|High Council]]. They would not have the opportunity.<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref>

When Bail Organa, [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] formally created the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], many Alderaanians volunteered their resources and lives, despite the still fresh memories of the Clone Wars. Many of the early warriors of the Alliance, and subsequently, many of its leaders and officers, were Alderaanian.

===Destruction of Alderaan===
{{Quote|Since you are reluctant to provide us with the location of the Rebel base, I have chosen to test this station's destructive power on your home planet of Alderaan.''"<br />"''No! Alderaan is peaceful. We have no weapons! You can't possibly&hellip;!''"<br />"''You would prefer another target? A military target? Then name the system!|Wilhuff Tarkin and Princess Leia|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Tarkin_by_Allen_Douglas_TCG.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin orders the destruction of Alderaan]]
Shortly after the (three-shot) [[Destruction of Despayre|destruction]] of [[Despayre]],<ref name="TEA" /> Alderaan was the first strategic target of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. In a demonstration of its power to Princess Leia, [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] ordered the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of her home, despite Leia's protest. While she claimed the planet was weaponless,<ref name="ANH" /> it is said it had some of the strongest defences in the Empire.<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> When Death Star [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] [[Tenn Graneet]] threw the switch to initiate primary ignition, power was channelled from the hypermatter reactor through the [[Superlaser/Legends|Superlaser]], coming out at superluminal velocity. This was the first known time the superlaser had fired a full-power beam.

The deaths of the billions of sentient people caused a massive [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] felt the disturbance while en route to the Alderaan system and told [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that it felt "as if millions of voices cried out in terror and were suddenly silenced."<ref name="ANH" /> On the Death Star, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Nova Stihl]] passed out from the shock of sensing all the deaths on Alderaan.<ref name="Death Star novel">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

The plan drastically backfired, driving thousands of beings to the Alliance cause, even in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and sending many planets in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] into open rebellion. A number of Alderaanians serving in the Imperial military defected to the Rebel Alliance after learning of their homeworld's destruction; among the defectors was the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]. The Imperials attempted to pin the blame for Alderaan's destruction on the Rebels, keeping a small number of people loyal to the Empire; however, the ruse convinced few.

===Post-Destruction===
{{Quote|The defense system on Alderaan, despite the Senator's protestations to the contrary, were as strong as any in the Empire.|Grand Moff Tarkin|<ref name="ANH novel" />}}
[[File:The_Graveyard.jpg|thumb|right|300px|[[The Graveyard]] of Alderaan]]

The remains of Alderaan became known as [[the Graveyard]] and many Alderaanians who were off-planet when Alderaan was destroyed performed a private ceremony called [[Return (Alderaanian)|the Returning]], and would shoot capsules filled with gifts for their friends and family. Some Alderaanian Exiles who called themselves the [[Guardians]], took to patrolling the Graveyard to prevent [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from stealing the capsules. These Alderaanians were held in rather high regard among the exiles.<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan" /> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his crew of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], were among the first to visit it in an attempt to bring [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], some time before the ''Falcon''{{'s}} navicomputer even listed Alderaan as destroyed.<ref name="ANH" />

In the months after the destruction of Alderaan, Imperial agents often lay in wait for ships performing a Returning ritual. They boarded the ships and arrested the passengers and crew. The Rebel Alliance considered quarantining the Graveyard, as these Imperial actions were too risky for the Alliance.<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a group of Alderaanians formed a colony on [[Ejolus]], but it was wiped out by the Empire only eight months after their homeworld's destruction.<ref name="Empire 35">[[Empire 35|''Empire'' 35]]</ref> However, shortly after the Ejolus colony was wiped out, the remaining refugees were taken in by the [[Alderaan Alliance]], who gave them residence on [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] discovered by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], Force-sensitive individuals such as [[Tenel Ka Djo]] could still feel echoes of the Force disturbance caused by the deaths of the planet's population. It was also at this time that [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] retrieved a piece of the planet's core, removed via [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], as a birthday gift for their mother, Leia.<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Shards of Alderaan">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shards of Alderaan]]''</ref>

After [[104 ABY]],<ref name="Celestia Galactica date">"[[Celestia Galactica Photografica]]" was included in ''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: Legacy Vol. 4]]'', which describes the stories it contains as taking place more than a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. That film took place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', meaning that all [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] in "Celestia Galactica Photografica," including ''[[Alderaan Refugees]]'', must have been created after [[104 ABY]].</ref> the planet was depicted in a painting<ref name="Inside Star Wars: Visionaries">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/comics/news20050315.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars: Visionaries''}}</ref> titled ''[[Alderaan Refugees]]''. The painting depicted various [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] on parked [[Starship/Legends|starships]] near an Alderaanian city.<ref name="Celestia Galactica Photografica">{{StoryCite|story=Celestia Galactica Photografica|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>

==Terrain==
[[File:Alderaan_mountains.png|thumb|left|300px|Alderaan's mountains.]]
Alderaan was the homeworld of some of the galaxy's most famous animals, such as the [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]], the [[Grazer (Alderaan)|grazer]] and the [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]].<ref name="TEA" /> Alderaanian cities were often built with great care taken to protect nature. One such city, [[Crevasse City (Alderaan)/Legends|Crevasse City]] was built on the walls of a canyon, nearly invisible from above. Others were built on stilts along the shoreline or under the polar ice. The capital, [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], known for its university, was built on a small island in the center of a caldera.

In the [[Castle Lands]], the remains of Killik mounds stood as a silent testament to the indigenous species that had disappeared for unknown reasons. Philosophers, poets, and artists often visited the Castle Lands for inspiration and meditation.

[[File:Alderaan_TFUcampaign2.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A landscape of Alderaan.]]
Alderaan was home to eight thousand species of grass<ref name="FF18">{{FactFile|18|ALD 1-4|Alderaan}}</ref> and an even larger number of wildflowers. Its flora also included a massive variety of spices, herbs, and grains. The planet had no major oceans, but it had a single polar ice cap. The rest of Alderaan's surface water was composed of thousands of lakes and connecting waterways.

==Society==
{{Quote|Any time is the time to visit Alderaan! How can one not enjoy a planet where peace and beauty are common preoccupations, and art and learning are the popular pastimes?|[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Tion]]|<ref name="Empire 5">[[Empire 5|''Empire'' 5]]</ref>}}
[[File:UniversityOfAldera.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]]]]
Alderaanian culture valued education, the performing and fine arts, and peaceful resolutions to conflicts. They placed high value in their participation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and later, its Imperial equivalent. The Alderaanians constantly sought a harmonious existence with their surroundings, evident in their integration of their society into the natural terrain of Alderaan. Alderaanians were known for love of philosophy.

The average Alderaanian was very educated and cultured. Poets and artists thrived on Alderaan. The beauty moved the pens of poets, while the vast grasslands served as a canvas for [[grass painting]]s. Alderaan was also famous for its cuisine. The large variety of spices and herbs allowed chefs to experiment and create some of the finest dishes in the galaxy. Steamed Alderaanian spiced wine was a favored beverage among many.

Some of the planet's major exports included wine, art, and luxury goods.<ref name="TEA" /> Alderaan was known as "Planet of Beauty,"<ref name="insta">{{Instagram|username=starwars|url=p/mvzntBs_S-|name=Star Wars|date=April 13, 2014|quote=#SpotlightOfTheWeek - Alderaan, the "Planet of Beauty." #StarWars|archivedate=20120605023033|archivefile=File:Instagram_Alderaan.png}}</ref>

==Government==
{{Quote|It's time Alderaan stopped resisting the Empire and started fighting it.|Leia Organa's position on the Galactic Civil War|<ref name="Radio">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:Aldera_City.png|300px|thumb|[[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], the planet's capital]]
Although a democratic society,<ref name="TEA" /> Alderaan was headed by a hereditary constitutional monarchy, with the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] presiding over the High Court and legislative [[High Council of Alderaan]]. Its monarchs have variously borne the titles "[[Prince/Legends|Prince]]," "[[First Chairman/Legends|First Chairman]]," "[[Queen/Legends|Queen]]," "[[King/Legends|King]]" and "[[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]]." Traditionally, the heir of the Alderaan throne also served in the High Council of Alderaan and a term as Senator of Alderaan. A [[Vizier/Legends|vizier]] helped the monarch rule, and many different [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Noble Houses]] each had considerable influence in government.

Alderaan's government deliberately halted itself from so much as questioning spacecraft leaving or arriving on the planet.

Three separate votes yielded no winner, and so the Alderaanians contacted the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], which sent a committee including [[Jorus C'baoth]] to resolve the contention. The participants considered the intricacies of the situation, and decided that House Organa bore the rightful claim to the throne in a month.<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] was the leader of Alderaan<ref name="TEA" /> and was on the planet when it was destroyed, while his heir and (secretly-adopted) daughter Princess Leia served as Senator of Alderaan in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[The Star Wars story synopsis|treatment]], [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]], [[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars|second draft]], and [[The Star Wars: From The Adventures of Luke Starkiller|third draft]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] in [[1973]]-[[1975]], Alderaan was the name of the capital of the [[Galactic Empire (The Star Wars)|New Galactic Empire]]. At that time, it was described as a [[Gas giant/Legends|giant gas]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that resembled [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], with a [[Imperial City of Alderaan|city]] that resembled [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on it.
[[File:Alderaan-TCWAssassin.png|thumb|left|280px|Alderaan as it appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'']]
The original name in the second draft of ''A New Hope'' for what would become Alderaan was [[Ogana Major]]. [[Aquilae (The Star Wars)|Aquilae]], [[Utapau (Kessil system)|Utapau]] and [[Ophuchi]] were also considered as names for worlds partially corresponding to Alderaan.<ref name="The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref>

[[Grindelwald]] in [[Wikipedia:Switzerland|Switzerland]] was scouted for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], to capture plate photography for backdrops on the planet Alderaan.

In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', during the part where [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], [[Carth Onasi]] and [[Bastila Shan]] are captured on the [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|Leviathan]], there is a dialog option to cite Alderaan as the location for the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]]. This was likely done as a joke, similar to how [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]] of Alderaan cites Dantooine as the location of the Rebel Base.

In ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', Alderaan is featured in the queue's "advertisements" for various Star Tours packages, where it is referred to as "the safest planet in the galaxy."<ref name="STad">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

The song "[[Wikipedia:Californication (song)|Californication]]" by the [[Wikipedia:Red Hot Chili Peppers|Red Hot Chili Peppers]] includes the lyrics "Space may be the final frontier/But it's made in a Hollywood basement/And Cobain can you hear the sphere/Singing songs of Station to Station/And Alderaan's not far away, it's Californication."
